subject: Performance coaching checkpoint & next steps for Q2
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Performance coaching kickoff — agreed outcomes and 30/60 plan

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for sitting down yesterday. I wanted to summarize the agreed coaching goals and the short-term checkpoints so we have a single reference. The intent here is corrective coaching (pre-PIP) with an emphasis on observable behaviors and measurable outcomes.

30-day priorities (to be demonstrated in day-to-day work):
- Timeliness: deliver code reviews and design comments within 48 hours for high-priority PRs.
- Communication: weekly async status updates on the project channel (short bullets — what I did, blockers, next steps).
- Collaboration: involve at least one peer reviewer earlier in design phase (before PR creation).

60-day measurable outcomes:
- Shipping two production fixes with no regressions and documented post-mortems (short one-pagers).
- Improved lead-time for PRs: median time from open to merge reduced by 30% for assigned tickets.

We agreed the cadence will be weekly 1:1s plus a formal checkpoint at 30 days. Monica will be copied into the checkpoint notes for HR visibility. Please find the coaching plan attached (coaching_plan_v1.pdf).

Next steps for you: confirm acceptance of the plan in reply and share the first weekly status by Fri, Mar 12.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Also attaching my notes from our 1:1 where we walked the plan through.

Hi Laura, Vivek —

I’m circling back to document the timeline and available support resources per our policy. Summary:
- Coaching period: Mar 10 (kickoff) — Apr 9 (30-day checkpoint).
- If insufficient progress at the 30-day checkpoint, we have a second 30-day extension option before any PIP conversation.
- Vivek is eligible to request a skills mentor (technical pairing) and up to two coaching sessions with People Ops for communication skills.

Please confirm you both have visibility into these options; I’ve added the Drive folder link to the related_links. For transparency, I’ll add the 30-day checkpoint notes to the HR case HR-Case-48291.

Thanks Monica — that all looks right. Vivek, quick ask ahead of our 1:1 tomorrow (Mar 25):
- Please add a short list (3 bullet maximum) of what you think is blocking you from hitting the 30-day targets.
- If you’d like pairing, flag the specific areas (tests, CI flakiness, infra ownership) so I can arrange a mentor.

Karthik, looping you in for visibility — if we reach the 60-day checkpoint and outcomes are still not met, we’ll discuss potential role adjustments rather than immediate escalation.

Laura
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly status & 30-day checkpoint notes (Mar 10 — Apr 2)

Laura / Monica / Karthik —

Short status covering Mar 10 — Apr 2 (per agreed format):
- What I did:
  - Delivered hotfix for KV-cache eviction bug (rolled out Mar 29).
  - Paired with Sana from infra to stabilize flaky e2e test; created a follow-up ticket to track CI improvements.
  - Posted weekly updates to #runtime-projects each Friday.

- Blockers:
  - Ownership gaps on the staging deployment automation slowed the hotfix turnaround.
  - I underestimated the regression risk on one legacy refactor; needed extra time to validate.

- Proposed next steps:
  - Request pairing for deployment automation from infra (Monica, can you help me request a short-term mentor?).
  - I’ll focus on improving PR turnaround by explicitly tagging reviewers and blocking unrelated churn.

Checkpoint assessment (my view): partial progress. I met several behavioral targets (regular updates, earlier peer involvement) and shipped one production fix, but lead time targets still need work. Happy to discuss in the 30-day checkpoint call next week.

Thanks for the support,
Vivek
